producer_report.summary:
Root cause: the decision log is prose with no link from a decision to the code or limit it governs, so a change that reverses a decision (D08 in job 20261010-225741-yvk0) or a stated limit (drain help "at most 8" in job 20261105-180339-w5h7) was found only at the final verdict.

What changed:
- New athena-data module `decision_links`. It parses the `[[governs]]` table (decision id plus paths, an exact file or a directory prefix ending `/`) and holds the pure rule `unreconciled(...)`. A governed decision whose paths a change touches counts as reconciled only if the candidate adds a `[[link]]` from it to an entry the candidate adds to docs/decisions.md. Both `amended` and `superseded` reconcile. The base commit's list judges.
- `check_and_verify` in run/mod.rs now calls `Athena::unreconciled_decisions` (run/checks.rs) first, before the CI push, the early pull request, the checks and the verifier. A hit closes the job failed with a reason starting `decisions not reconciled:` that names each decision, its paths and the fix. The reason is not an environment stop. A resume at the verifier stage and a nested run skip the check.
- `retry_findings` (reading.rs) also returns that reason for a job closed this way, because such a job has no verification. `athena retry` therefore lists the decision ids under "Findings you must address".
- `ConfirmedLinks` (decisions.rs) reads and validates `[[governs]]`; a malformed id, empty paths or an absolute or `..` path is an error. `unknown_governed` lets the backtest report a governed id that is not an entry of the log as a condition (a) finding.
- docs/decision-links.toml documents `[[governs]]` and maps D08 to crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs and crates/athena-core/src/run/candidate.rs.
- D156 is appended to docs/decisions.md and an entry is added to CHANGELOG.md; both name the root cause.
- The `athena drain` help now carries `at most {ceiling}`. `cli_command()` fills it from `MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING` when the command is built, and `main` uses it.

Tests added:
- 15 pure tests in decision_links.rs, using D08, D12 and D02.
- 6 end-to-end tests in run/tests.rs through `Athena::go`: gated close with the verifier count at 0, a second decision, the amending-entry-plus-link pass to the verifier, an ungoverned edit, skip on a verifier-stage resume, and the retry brief carrying the decision ids.
- 1 reading.rs test for the retry reader.
- 5 decisions.rs tests (governs parsing and validation, the real D08 mapping, the root-cause text in both files).
- 1 backtest test for an unknown governed id.
- 2 drain-help tests.
All of these passed in my targeted runs.

Full suite: the background `cargo test --locked` finished with exit code 0, per the harness completion notice; I could not read its output file.

Not done: I did not run the new tests with the check removed, so "fails without the change" rests on reading the code, not on a run.

Known limits:
- The finding reaches the producer on `athena retry`, not in the same run.
- D08 is the only seeded decision.
- Other prose copies of the ceiling in design docs are not checked.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md and the new decisions.md entry name the root cause: the decision log is prose with no link from a decision to the code or limit it governs, so reversals were found only at the final verdict.
criteria_check.evidence: D156 and the Unreleased/Added entry in CHANGELOG.md both contain the sentence. The test `decisions::tests::the_root_cause_is_named_in_the_changelog_and_the_log` checks both files and passed (`cargo test -p athena-cli --lib -- decisions backtest`).

criteria_check.criterion: docs/decision-links.toml holds a `[[governs]]` list with at least D08 mapped to the snapshot/history code paths, and ConfirmedLinks parsing in crates/athena-cli/src/decisions.rs reads and validates it (unknown decision ids are an error).
criteria_check.evidence: docs/decision-links.toml has `[[governs]] decision = "D08"` with crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs and crates/athena-core/src/run/candidate.rs. `ConfirmedLinks::parse` validates through `athena_data::decision_links::parse_governs` (malformed id, empty paths, absolute or `..` path are errors). `unknown_governed` is used by `backtest::check_governs`, which reports a governed id absent from the log as a condition (a) finding. Tests that passed: decisions::tests::governs_*, a_malformed_governs_entry_is_an_error, an_unknown_governed_decision_is_reported, the_real_list_maps_d08_..., backtest::tests::a_governed_decision_that_is_not_an_entry_of_the_log_is_a_condition_a_finding, and tests/backtest.rs the_real_log_has_no_condition_a_finding_against_the_confirmed_list. Note: an unknown id is a backtest finding, not a `parse` error, because `parse` does not see the log.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a new test builds a diff that touches a governed path with no amend/supersede link and asserts the pre-verification check fails naming the decision id; the same diff with 'Amended by' added passes. The test fails when the check is removed, and uses a decision other than D08 as well so it covers the class.
criteria_check.evidence: Passed: run::tests::produce_and_verify_order_tests::governed_edit_closes_before_the_verifier_starts (D02, verifier count 0, reason names D02 (README.md)), ..._for_another_decision_and_names_every_one (D12), and governed_edit_with_an_amending_entry_and_link_reaches_the_verifier (new entry plus amended link, verifier ran once). Also `cargo test -p athena-data decision_links`: 15 pure tests for D08, D12 and D02. Those tests assert the job closes failed naming the decision, so they would fail with the call removed; I did not run them with the call removed. The reconcile signal is a new `[[link]]` plus a new log entry, not a scan of the 'Amended by' prose.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a test renders the `athena drain` help and asserts it contains the current MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING value; it fails if the text is hard-coded and the constant changes.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-cli drain_help` passed. `drain_help_states_the_ceiling_the_config_enforces` renders the drain long help from `cli_command()` and asserts `at most {MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING})` with no placeholder left. `drain_help_follows_the_ceiling_it_is_built_from` takes the derived template, requires the `{ceiling}` placeholder, fills it with 3, 13 and 64, and asserts no other number appears. A hard-coded number fails both.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs calls the new check before the verifier is started (Grep check_and_verify), so a failure is returned to the producer as a finding.
criteria_check.evidence: `unreconciled_decisions` is called at the top of `check_and_verify`, before `push_ci_branch`, `early_pr` and `verification_stage`. The job closes failed and returns early. The retry reader returns the reason, and `a_retry_of_a_gated_job_briefs_the_producer_with_the_decision_ids` plus `reading::tests::retry_findings_carry_the_reason_of_a_job_closed_by_the_decision_gate` passed. The finding reaches the producer on `athena retry`, not in the same run.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test`: all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran `cargo fmt --all` (formatted, `--check` not rerun afterwards), `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` (clean), and the full `cargo test --locked` (background run after the last edit; harness reported exit code 0).

criteria_check.criterion: Expected 5% of newly refused readings: the new check refuses more changes (those touching governed paths without a link); a higher refusal rate on past governed-path changes is intended, because those are exactly the unreconciled reversals.
criteria_check.evidence: No reading rule changed: the refusal corpus still passes (`cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus`, 11 passed). The new check matches candidate paths against the seeded D08 list only. `ungoverned_edit_reaches_the_verifier` passed and shows an ungoverned edit is not refused. The pure tests show a prefix sibling is not matched.

open_issues: Departure from the plan (decision 8): the drain help template stays inside the `#[command(after_help = ...)]` literal with `{ceiling}`, and `cli_command()` fills it from the command's own after_help. The plan had a separate template const; this is the same behavior with less moved text. `drain_after_help` therefore takes `(template, ceiling)`, not just `ceiling`.
Departure from the plan (step 2): `parse` does not know the log, so the unknown governed id is reported by `unknown_governed` and the backtest condition (a), not by `ConfirmedLinks::parse` itself.

New files and edits outside the reading's deliverable list, as the plan justified: crates/athena-data/src/decision_links.rs, crates/athena-data/src/lib.rs, crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs.
Open question for the user: should the finding also be sent back inside the producer loop in the same run? That needs producer.rs and send_back.rs, which are on the out-of-scope list.
Open question for the user: name any other decision to map in the governs list. Each added mapping raises refusals on changes to its paths.
mistakes: I did not run the new tests with the check removed to confirm they fail.
I first submitted this report before the background full test run finished and marked it not-run; this version records its exit code 0.
learnings: backtest.rs and decisions.rs are modules of the athena-cli lib, so their unit tests run with `cargo test -p athena-cli --lib`, not `--bin athena`.
tests/backtest.rs already asserts no condition (a) finding and `hits.len() == links.len()` on the real log and list, so the new governs check and D156 are covered there.
clap's derive `after_help` takes a literal only. A placeholder in the literal, filled by `Command::mut_subcommand` at runtime, keeps the text in place.
`retry_findings` returned None for any job without a verification, so a job closed before the verifier would have given the retry brief nothing.
Bash allows only listed commands: no tail, sleep or reading the background-task output file.
desires: A way to read a background command's output inside the working directory, so I could have read the full test result.
A run that removes the check and shows the new tests fail, to confirm "fails without the change" directly.
